denial_type_rationale: Pre-service authorization for 27447 was denied under the payer's TKA medical policy (PA-DN-14) before surgery was performed.
reasons_for: The denial rests solely on missing PT documentation; a Northgate PT discharge summary documents 14 visits over about 12 weeks with no improvement (KOOS JR 48.0 to 46.5).
Conservative care far exceeds the two-modality minimum: NSAIDs for more than 12 months, two corticosteroid injections, PT with HEP, cane, and weight counseling.
Weight-bearing X-rays show KL grade 4 bone-on-bone medial OA, meeting the imaging criterion.
BMI 31.4, HbA1c 6.4%, never smoker and documented shared decision-making satisfy the remaining criteria.
reasons_against: The payer did not evaluate criteria 1, 2 and 4-6 in full, so it could raise new issues on appeal.
The HbA1c date should be confirmed as within 3 months of the planned surgery date.
recommended_strategy: File a standard pre-service appeal with the Northgate PT discharge summary and both injection notes attached, walking through all six MP-ORTHO-031 criteria. Consider requesting a peer-to-peer within the 14-day window to speed up approval before the planned surgery date.
